Get LBA Player Stats

Source: R/lba.R
lba_player_stats.Rd

A player's career by championship: per-game averages, single-game highs and totals.

Endpoint: GET https://www.legabasket.it/api/players/get-player-stats (id=<player_id>)

Usage

lba_player_stats(player_id)

Arguments

player_id

(required) Player id (player_id in lba_players or a box score), e.g. 969. Global: one id for a whole career.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: A player's career by championship: per-game averages, single-game highs and totals. The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py lba_player_stats); a column the site adds later is appended after them:

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id (global: one id for a whole career); the request's player.
stat_typecharacterStatistic of the row: avg (per game), max (single-game high) or sum (total).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27): the row's START year + 1.
championship_yearintegerSeason START year (2026 = 2026-27); sdv END year = year + 1.
championship_positionintegerDisplay order of the competition within the season (1 = Regular Season; inferred).
championship_namecharacterCompetition name (Regular Season, Play Off, Coppa Italia, ...).
team_namecharacterTeam name in that season, with its sponsor (Nutribullet Treviso Basket); changes with the sponsor.
quintetintegerPer-game average of starts (in the starting five) in that season, competition and team.
pointsdoublePer-game average of points in that season, competition and team.
played_minutesdoublePer-game average of minutes played in that season, competition and team.
played_matchesintegerGames played in that season, competition and team: a count, the same in the avg, max and sum rows.
total_matchesintegerTeam games while the player was listed (a player with 3 of 21 shows 21; inferred) in that season, competition and team: a count, the same in the avg, max and sum rows.
done_foulsintegerPer-game average of fouls committed in that season, competition and team.
suffered_foulsintegerPer-game average of fouls drawn in that season, competition and team.
shots_2p_realizeddoublePer-game average of 2-point field goals made in that season, competition and team.
shots_2p_totalintegerPer-game average of 2-point field goals attempted in that season, competition and team.
slam_dunkintegerPer-game average of dunks in that season, competition and team.
shots_3p_realizedintegerPer-game average of 3-point field goals made in that season, competition and team.
shots_3p_totalintegerPer-game average of 3-point field goals attempted in that season, competition and team.
free_throws_realizedintegerPer-game average of free throws made in that season, competition and team.
free_throws_totalintegerPer-game average of free throws attempted in that season, competition and team.
offensive_reboundintegerPer-game average of offensive rebounds in that season, competition and team.
defensive_reboundintegerPer-game average of defensive rebounds in that season, competition and team.
total_reboundintegerPer-game average of total rebounds in that season, competition and team.
ball_stop_givenintegerPer-game average of blocks in that season, competition and team.
ball_stop_receivedintegerPer-game average of own shots blocked in that season, competition and team.
lost_ballsintegerPer-game average of turnovers in that season, competition and team.
regain_ballsintegerPer-game average of steals in that season, competition and team.
assistsintegerPer-game average of assists in that season, competition and team.
rating_legaintegerPer-game average of LBA efficiency rating (valutazione) in that season, competition and team.
rating_oerdoublePer-game average of OER (points / (FGA + turnovers + FTA / 2)) in that season, competition and team.
avg_pointsdoublePer-game average of plus-minus, despite the name (see the game-log row, where it equals the box score plus_minus) in that season, competition and team.
aplus_dpintegerPer-game average of aplus_dp, an unverified metric (not plus-minus or assists: Macura 2026-27 has 9 against plus-minus 8 and 3 assists) in that season, competition and team.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the JSON API that the Next.js site www.legabasket.it itself calls. Legal notice: the site's terms say "Non e' consentito copiare ... dati e informazioni senza autorizzazione scritta" (copying data and information without written authorisation is not allowed), except for personal, non-commercial use. The owner accepted the restriction for this intake on 2026-10-12. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and any published data release of this source needs separate sign-off.

  • robots.txt allows /api and sets Crawl-delay: 2. The runtime waits 2 s before every request, retries included. Crawl incrementally: fetch a final game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one lba_calendar call per round, and do not backfill a history in a burst.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026-27); the site sends START years and the runtime maps them (season - 1 on the wire). Game and player ids are global; team ids are re-issued every season (join lba_teams for the stable club_id); a championship id is one season AND one phase (Regular Season and Play Off differ).

  • Play-by-play starts in 2017-18 and changes shape in 2019-20 (pixel frame to court percent) and 2021-22; see lba_pbp. Box scores reach back to 1995-96, where the period scores were not recorded (0 means missing).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or a body with no rows: an unknown season, a play-by-play before 2017-18, standings of a finished championship without a round), hoopR_bad_request (a season that is not an END year, a bad choice, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, an empty / non-JSON / error-shaped 200, a game that is not final on the box score, play-by-play and shot routes, a truncated page, or a body for another season, championship, game, team, player, round or category than the one asked for). An unknown id is HTTP 500, which is not retried. A body the parser finds no rows in gives a zero-row tibble with these columns.
